title: E-FND-0069: the E8 lattice vector count at squared length 2n equals 240 times the sum of cubes of divisors of n...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0069 in the foundations arena: the E8 lattice vector count at squared length 2n equals 240 times the sum of cubes of divisors of n (240, 2160, 6720) by direct enumeration, so the magic-square corner theta series is the Eisenstein series E4, while wrong divisor powers do not match.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
